onDate.title: Balance on a date
onDate.label: Date
onDate.projectedHint: Counts the monthly credits still to come, approved leave and requests waiting for a decision.

ledger.title: History
ledger.emptyHint: The first monthly credit or the opening balance will appear here.

adjust.openingHint: State the balance as of the day before monthly credits start.
adjust.openingNoStartDate: Monthly credits have no start date yet, so today's date is proposed.
adjust.reasonHint: The reason is kept in the history and shown to the employee.

adjust.amountPositive: Enter a number greater than zero.
adjust.reasonRequired: Give the reason. It is kept in the history.
